links.outcome: Accuracy of AI chart review versus manual review for extracting variables
links.effect: OphthoACR achieved 94% accuracy in extracting variables of interest, significantly outperforming manual review (83%); 97% specificity, 92% sensitivity, Cohen's κ 0.70.
links.quote: OphthoACR achieved 94% accuracy in extracting variables of interest, significantly outperforming manual review (83%).

unlisted_practices: AI-automated retrospective chart review for research cohort data extraction

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates OphthoACR, a fine-tuned LLM tool for automated chart review, comparing its performance to manual and AI-assisted chart reviews on retrospective electronic health record data without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
